notes.title: 📢 A Note About Future Releases on Steam
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]First off – thank you so much for the amazing support since the release of [i]Jessica’s Choices – Origins[/i]. The feedback and encouragement has meant the world, and it’s keeping me motivated to keep building this story out further.[/p][p]I want to be open with you about something that’s recently come to light regarding Steam’s publishing rules. It looks like Steam has made changes that directly affect how developers of adult/mature-themed games can release content.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Early Access is no longer available for games with adult/mature content[/b] – meaning episodic releases (where one part is released now and later parts follow) are being rejected by Steam.
🔹 This also means I won’t be able to use the old “episodic” style of releases to get new content out to you quickly.
🔹 Steam’s path forward for these kinds of games seems to be either:[/p][list][*][p]releasing a [i]fully completed[/i] game, or[/p][/*][*][p]adding additional content later as [b]DLC[/b] updates.[/p][/*][/list][p]What this means for [i]Jessica’s Choices[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]The first release is already live and will stay available everywhere at the moment.[/p][/*][*][p]I [b]still plan to release future content on Steam[/b], but I may have to adjust how and when it gets delivered so that it fits within these new rules.[/p][/*][*][p]My goal is to continue telling Jessica’s story — just know that the release format may be different than originally planned.[/p][/*][/list][p]I’ll keep you all updated as I learn more. For now, please know I’m committed to finishing the story and making sure you get to experience it — whether that’s through Steam (as DLC/updates) or potentially other distribution options if needed.[/p][p]Thank you again for your patience and support. These changes caught a lot of indie devs by surprise, but we’ll adapt together. 💜[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, have a little look at some of the below for what is coming soon.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/c010c928a929a4fb0ef67dff66225f448e63f646.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/a528faf69769f91c411222e676838d4fbaf423d5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/c1650a45501150641e53eca2442a9d1ee9c86b3c.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/8a6239642e72b2cc6d02680a043a3a442d623a04.jpg"][/img]— DoAdventures[/p]

notes.title: An Update on Jessica’s Choices – Forced
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I just wanted to give you a quick update, especially for those wondering why there hasn't been much news on [i]Jessica’s Choices – Forced[/i] here on Steam yet.[/p][p]Unfortunately, I’ve hit a few bumps with the Steam review process. The game is going through extended checks due to its mature content and branching narrative. Because of this, I haven't been able to set up the store page or share official info directly through the platform — [i]yet[/i].[/p][p][b]The good news?[/b]
Development is going [i]really well[/i]. The current build of [i]Forced[/i] is already [b]2.47GB[/b], with [b]over 800 brand-new renders[/b], bringing the total in-game render count to [b]2,435[/b] so far. And yes — that includes plenty of bold, intense, and emotional moments that continue directly from where [i]Origins[/i] left off.[/p][p]Here’s just a small taste of what’s coming your way:
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/28b9e99989f1e02fd70da3badb4fdea551ade72e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/660c29c4985e9186ddcd5a388872ff113d047101.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/573e94c9437d042acefc9b45d3e916154a1e7c48.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/62d415cccade8992ba0e062f119aeb3eeacc751c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/360226c40db7417654e55f6449e5c6c29f5e826c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/9108165666dd2dcf4ee3256974a9cfa0f5ff429b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all so much for your support and patience — it really means a lot. I’ll keep you updated as soon as Steam gives the green light on the store page.[/p][p]In the meantime, if you did like [i]Jessica’s Choices – Origins, [/i]please leave a review[i].[/i]
—DoAdventures[/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Jessica’s Choices – Origins: Final Release is LIVE! 🔥
notes.content:
After months of work, passion, and countless player decisions, the full version of Jessica’s Choices – Origins is here.
This is the final major update to the origin story before I move forward into Jessica’s future with "Forced"

🖼️ What's New in This Release?
Over 700+ new renders
Four animations
UI Overhaul — a refreshed look to enhance immersion and polish the experience

💔 Scene Additions & Continuations:
Jessica with Ben – sweet, awkward, and filled with unspoken tension
Jessica with Michelle – dominant, tempting, calculated
Jessica with Ben & Michelle – things finally reach a boiling point
The Steph shower scene – extended and dripping with hesitation and heat
The Steven shower scene – Jessica's confusion deepens... so does the touch
The asleep scene with Steven – dream or memory? You decide
Recaps and revelations surrounding the homeless man and homeless woman — and what happened before she woke up

 🎮 Now Available – Jessica’s Choices – Origins Final Release
💬 Reviews, shares, and support help immensely as we head toward what’s next.

notes.title: 🎄 Jessica’s Christmas Cheer: A Naughty Night with Big Red! 🎅

Ho ho ho, everyone! The holidays are here, and Jessica’s been getting into the festive spirit—emphasis on spirit! 😏 Unfortunately, I’ve been struggling with a little Grinch-y tech issue preventing me from posting this in the Artwork folder (two weeks and counting, Steam support has been about as helpful as a lump of coal).

But let’s not let a little tech trouble dampen the holiday fun, because Jessica has been very naughty this year—and Big Red has noticed! In this special holiday set, Jessica finds herself at a strip bar with Santa and two of his merry little helpers. Let’s just say this isn’t your typical Christmas carol night. 😉

🎁 What’s in store? Jessica giving Big Red a dance he won’t soon forget, getting showered with early "gifts," and discovering that Santa's "naughty list" might come with a few perks. And those elves? They’re definitely on board for the festivities.

I’ll post these festive renders as soon as the Artwork folder behaves itself, but for now, know that Jessica’s Christmas is one for the ages.

Stay tuned—and keep your stockings hung high, because Big Red’s bringing more than just candy canes this year! 🍭🔥

notes.title: Episode 4 Releasing
notes.content:
Hey everyone! I'm excited to announce that the updated version of Jessica's Choices - Origins is going through now! 🎉 However, I want to be upfront about a few challenges I've faced with this release, so please bear with me as I walk you through what’s new and what to expect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/8479ae1cf18dbdd7945c1f892ee859b3dc1313f5.jpg[/img]

[b]Translations[/b]:
While most of the scripts are now translated for French, Spanish, Russian, Chinese and German, I encountered some issues with translating choice menus and character names. These will be addressed in a future patch, so thank you for your patience!

[b]Music Implementation:[/b]
The new music system works perfectly for new games, enhancing the immersion as you explore Jessica’s journey. However, it won’t apply to existing saves. Skips are still available for scenes you’ve already played, so you can dive right back in without losing progress and getting to the new stuff.
I sincerely apologise for these hiccups and appreciate your understanding. 💙

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/86f644c44b85663a730fb17d94900e9ca189fca5.jpg[/img]

[b]🌟 New Features and Content[/b]
Meet Sarah and Her Family:
Get introduced to Sarah, her mother, and her sibling. The sibling’s gender will depend on your choices, adding a personal touch to the story and deepening the branching possibilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/816455f6a81027e4bb5d8e414b073600b3822963.jpg[/img]

[b]Four Unique Scenarios for Jessica’s Abduction:[/b]
Experience Jessica’s kidnapping in four different ways as George escorts her from the police station. Each scenario offers distinct emotions, challenges, and consequences.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/86f644c44b85663a730fb17d94900e9ca189fca5.jpg[/img]

[b]Michelle and Ben’s Intensifying Dynamics:[/b]
Delve deeper into Michelle and Ben’s unsettling yet intriguing relationship. You’ll have the choice to guide Jessica toward continuing her interactions—or stepping away entirely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/1d102d2472dec498c2041925260f06175eec4255.jpg[/img]

[b]The Aftermath of the Homeless Encounter:[/b]
Jessica’s life takes an unexpected turn based on her interaction with the homeless man or woman. Their actions will leave a profound impact, shaping her journey moving forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/efa64c73f6f324ff313d9a4dea2d1a79539a0e06.jpg[/img]

[b]The Old Man/Woman and Cassie’s Introduction:[/b]
Navigate tense and dangerous moments as Jessica confronts the old man or woman, setting the stage for a thrilling new chapter. Plus, meet Cassie, a pivotal character whose role evolves depending on your choices.

notes.title: Game Update: Progress Report on Jessica’s Choices – Origins
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/2d786014d7ec646863ed7d22d5f56ce200bf32e6.jpg[/img]

I'm excited to share the latest update on Jessica’s Choices – Origins. Development is moving forward steadily, and as of now, I've completed 348 renders. The creative process is in full swing, and I have at least three more scenes to finalise before the next release. Each scene brings the story closer to crafting the experience I envisioned from the start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/647edbdad03dadb5d62deeba7b9a1022aabefd53.jpg[/img]

As the script evolves, I’m continually updating and refining it to capture every layer of Jessica's story. Testing is also well underway, ensuring everything runs smoothly and enhances the player experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/381aa27b0fc375630ff8c38564983761c8769ad1.jpg[/img]

One challenge I’m facing right now is with the in-game music selection feature, which I know many of you are excited about. I want players to enjoy a truly customisable audio experience, picking songs that resonate with each moment of gameplay. However, getting the game to remember those song choices has been challenging. Persistent variables, save configurations, you name it, I’ve tried it. It’s been a journey of trial and error, but I’m committed to getting it right, even if it’s been a bit of a headache!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/d81c9dd9919bd0333d251485d12e0e9597888785.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your continued support and patience. Each day brings me closer to release, and I can’t wait for you to experience everything that’s coming together. Keep an eye out for more updates soon!

DoAdventures

notes.title: Translations, New Features, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Translations, New Features, and More![/b]

Hi everyone!

I'm excited to share that renders are progressing smoothly for the next update! In addition to this, I'm working hard to include translations for French, Spanish, Italian, and hopefully Russian in the upcoming release. This should make the game more accessible to a wider audience, so thank you for your patience while I finalise these translations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/685e2f507ae94803bf61b3f727ac22f3dbb1e492.jpg[/img]

As mentioned before, the jukebox feature will also be live, giving you more control over your in-game experience, allowing you to choose the music that accompanies your playthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/082cbf3adc6d8c8a2438402bcdba3422be165af5.jpg[/img]

On top of that, I’ve added a new screen at start up to inform players that the game includes a lot of choices—some of which drastically affect the length of the experience. I’ve received some feedback that the game seems short, but this is heavily dependent on the route you choose. For those who might be rushing through the game (spamming the space bar to get to the renders), the experience will naturally be shorter. However, even when I personally skip through all paths, it takes me at least 30 minutes to see everything the game has to offer at the moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/0b25a4b124be8b59cc2b99625b2087a3a5678631.jpg[/img]

I encourage everyone to take their time and explore the different choices and branches—you may discover new content that’s easy to miss on a single playthrough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/72201e794e22eb274e392b4535cf3c830bb6a0be.jpg[/img]

As always, thank you for the amazing feedback and support, if I could ask you to leave me a review that would be really helpful. I can't wait to bring you these new features soon!

Thank you,
DoAdventures

notes.title: Jessica's Choices - Origins
notes.content:
[h3]🌟 It's time! 🌟[/h3]

October! You've never looked more beautiful. I'm glad to finally announce.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/2d19d313b76070e00473f5aa4480dc7adb46ee8a.jpg[/img]

[b]Jessica’s Choices – Origins[/b] is set to arrive on Steam this month! Step into Jessica's world, where every decision shapes her fate and the future of the three follow-up games: [b]Forced[/b], [b]Prison[/b], and [b]RED[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/9f0debfb9cf8754f312c04db7ab965a81607ba80.jpg[/img]

Dive deep into an intricate narrative where [b]your choices matter[/b]. Will Jessica make allies, fall in love, or walk a darker path? Each decision leads to a unique experience: explore friendship, enmity, innocence, or indulge in the hidden desires of a cruel, unforgiving world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/64409446854c1fa42cd7f39ffc605d205fd8e7f0.jpg[/img]

[b]Experience heartache, passion, acceptance, and growth[/b] as you guide Jessica through a world that both tempts and torments her. Her journey will challenge her boundaries, question her morality, and push you to decide, who will Jessica become?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/c2e27a743826f5851b244b7166022c83bea6a22a.jpg[/img]

While the game is [b]not in early access[/b], it will continue to [b]evolve with regular updates[/b], all provided within this package until the full version is completed — expected by the end of Q1 2025.

Prepare yourself for unforgettable moments and character development as Jessica’s story unfolds in ways that will leave you questioning every choice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45112947/d1fd2b8b380f4c347d0d866d164652316ce24bee.jpg[/img]

Keep a look out for the release date to be announced!

Thanks,
DoAdventures
